content: Chowe Jesus Ye Mol Ffesangur Bo Re Dabeyal
Seral ngo Jesus ye su wol ngachel Laom we Gennesaret ngo yarmat resa rol hadibal ngali bo rebe rongrong molwe yalol Deus.
Ye sala wiri ruyay boat le resa hasredah wulpiy. Chol fita kowe resa ligdi boat kowe re sala tetaldi fedaley wug kowe yar.
Jesus yesa chudah yuchul seyay boat kowe le wal Simon. Yesa kangalu bo be hattawey sugfed boat we tang piy. Jesus yesa maroro yuchul boat we sa fofoloy ngalir buwa we.
Yodwe yela mol yal hapatpat ngo Jesus sa kangalu Simon bo, “Hattawey sugfed boat le lobosla ye yod ngo hasa halgaloh wug we yami bo habe fita.”
Simon sa sor bo, “Masta, sa bongwe chog yamem fita yee la ral loh ngo tor mele ha hola. Iwe ngo hare ila sengal le ho sor, ila ngo ha bele halgaloh wug ka yamem.”
Iwe resa halgaloh wug we yar ngo hasfaluy lepal yig le ye bulong iyang le sa fesugfed ngo bele towas wug we iyang.
Iwe resa hagil ngalir rechokwe choluwar yuchul boat we seyay bo rebe budoh tipingir. Iwe re sala budoh resa hayda boat we ruyay yee la ssogloh le resa momos.
Yodwe Simon Pedrus yela wiri molwe yesa iwe sengal ngo yesa hasubgudiy mo imol Jesus ngo yesa kangalu bo, “Chuy mo irey ho Samol bo ngang semal choto hamolfid!”
Ye te medaf Simon mo mokwe choluwal irel lepal yig kowe resa hola.
Wol ila senger chowe rumal we chilal Simon, James mo John we lol Zebedee. Jesus sa kangal Simon bo, “Ho towe motog, bo bele chaep igla sa loh ngo hami ha bele fita yarmat.”
Iwe resa yuradah boat kowe wulpiy ngo resa tahcheloh pangal formel, resa dabey Jesus.
Jesus Ye Hachuya Mesel Pekel Mo Uwol Semal Mal

Sew yad le Jesus ye mel woal sew haplom ngo ye wol mel semal mal iyang le yesa hafohoy irel mesel pekel. Yodwe yela wiri chog Jesus ngo yesa haborohdi wototol ngo yesa kangalu bo, “Hare ye fel mo lal depom temay ngo be yoh le hobe hachuya tomay le mo uwoy.”
Jesus sa cchangloh sala yangsi mal we ngo sa sor bo, “Ngo, ye fel mo lal depey bele chuy tomay la mo uwom.” Yodwe chog ngo sa chuyloh meswe mo uwol mal we.

Iwe Jesus yesa hatobtob ngal mal we bo tor semal le be kangalu. Iwe ngo yesa kangalu bo, ho loh irel temarong we bo be kemahoh. Iwe ngo hosa fang maligach we Moses ye sor bo yebe mel bo sew hagil ngal pangal yarmat le yesa chuy mesel pekel we mo uwom.
Iwe sala far palengloh molwe kaptal Jesus. Buwa kowe resa budoh irel bo rebe talenga yal hapatpat ngo ye hachuya yar tomay.
Iwe ngo Jesus yema toaloh lobos kowe tema yor yarmat iyang bo bela mapel.
Jesus Ye Hachuya Yael Semal Mal Mahatugut

Seral le Jesus ye fofoloy ngo re maroro tot Pharisees mo tot mokwe sensel Hatobtob we loboswe le re budoh mo Jerusalem mo wol pangal mokwe haplomol Galilee mo Judea. Molwe kkamelal Deus ila yesa mel uwol Jesus bo yebe yoh le be hachuya yael yarmat tomay.
Ye sala budoh tot yarmat le re hasidoh semal mal le ye mahatugut le ye mel lal sew chob. Re luluwaley bo rebe hasilong yilim bo re bela holadiy mo imol Jesus.
Iwe ngo tor solbos le rebe dohlong mo iyang bo sa hadibal hamas yarmat. Iwe resa hasidah woal wungul imw we resa hattare solbos mo woal imw we resa habidiyo chotomay we mo imol Jesus lal longob we.
Yodwe Jesus yela wiri kkelel tugul we yar rechokwe ngo yesa kangalu mal we bo, “Maryerey, sa chuy fael yam molfid.”

Mokwe sensel Hatobtob we mo Pharisees kowe resa chapiy yar lunglung fengal le re sor bo, “Itey mal le ye kekapaliyel ngal Deus? Tor semal yarmat le be yoh le be hachuya fael molfid bo halachog Deus mele be yoh irel!”
Jesus ye gola luluwal kowe yar ngo sa kangalur bo, “Meda fal le ila sengal yami luluwal iyang?
Ifa sew le ye mechrag le iy be sor, ‘Yesa chuy fal yam molfid’ hare iy be sor bo, ‘Sudah hobe darloh’?

Ila ibele kkewar ngalugmi le mala Layur Retalop ila yor kkelal woal talople bo yebe hachuya fael molfid.” Iwe yesa kangal mal we ye mahatgut bo, “Ibe kangalug igla, sudah hosa hasi chob la giyem hosa loh lubugtam.”
Irel yodwe chog ngo mal we yesa sudah mo imol panger yarmat ngo yesa hasi molwe giyal sa loh lubugtal le yesa kkapingpinga Deus.
Pangerloh rechokwe ngo resa rol lluwdah. Iwe ngo yesa kkel yar rol motog. Iwe resa hapingpinga Deus le re sor bo, “Moch igla mele siya wiri tot formel le tediyor mwo mo fael sew le si wiri!”
Jesus Ye Ffesangu Levi
Yela wol miril ngo yesa loh Jesus sala wiri semal chol hateyel paliyel raeg le rema sor bo Levi le ye maroro lal yofis la yal. Jesus sa kangalu bo, “Dabeyey.”
Levi yesa ttahchadiy pangal formel yesa dabey Jesus.
Iwe Levi yesa foru sew gubul le ye paleng irel imw we imwal bo yael Jesus. Ye cholop chol hateyel paliyel raeg mo wol tot yarmat le re mel irer.

Tot Pharisees mo tot mokwe sensel Hatobtob we choluwar re lunglung ngal mokwe redabeyel Jesus le re sor bo, “Meda mele hala mongoy ngo ha yul ngalir chol hateyel paliyel raeg mo rechokla yarmat rete dipli wegdegir iyang?”
Jesus sa kangalur bo, “Rechoka rete tomay ila tor fal le togta be loh irer, bo rechokla re tomay togta ye mela tefael mo irer.
Ite budoh le ibe ffesangur rechokla re momay, bo ibudoh ffesangur ika re tohamolfid bo yebe rrig lal deper.”
Kasiyel Kofal Yach Ma Supiy Halach

Tot yarmat re kangalu Jesus bo, “Mokwe redabeyel Johannes ila rema tosupiy haler ngo re mapel ngo wol ila mele mokwe redabeyar Pharisees kowe rema foru. Ngo ikla redabeyem ila re tema poloh mo irel mongoy mo yul.”
Jesus sa kangalur bo, “Ha luluwaley ngo be yoh le habe hapolohor chol gubulul sew habulupoy le re towe mongoy irel yodla ye chil mel mal la ye habulupoy irer? Towe yoh!
Ye mel ralla rebe hasi tangir mal we ye habulupoy. Iwe ngo ir re bele moch supiy haler.”

Jesus yesa wol kangalur sew fiyong le ye sor bo, “Tor semal le yema mesreyi sedep mengag le ye tefoy yesa depecha ngal sew le sa sulay. Hare be ila sengal ngo bele hatawsi mengag we ye tefoy. Bo madpil mengag we ye tefoy ila towe hafedeg ngal iwe yesa sulay.

Ngo tor semal le yema yitetlong wine ka chil tefoy lal liliyel wine ka sa sulay bo be towas. Hare be ila sengal ngo be towasloh liliyel wine we sa sulay sala serloh wine we chil tefoy. Ila ngo tayor mele sibe chil tapeli ngali liliyel wine we sa sulay.
Wine ka ye tefoy ila ye momay le be bulong chog lal liliyel wine ka ye tefoy.
Tor semal le bela wol miril yal yul wine ka sa sulay ngo be chil mechal le be yul ika ye tefoy. Yebe sor bo, ‘Wine ka yesa sulay mele ye momay.’”
